account.metaDescription: Your Explora School account: bookings, progress and lessons in Sierra Nevada.
account.alreadyTitle: Have you already had lessons with Explora?
account.alreadyLead: If you have booked or skied with us before, we look up your lessons with the same Google email. If this is your first time, we set up your profile.
account.alreadyNo: No, this is my first time
account.linkMiss: We couldn't find bookings with this email. Complete your profile and, if you booked with another email, message us on WhatsApp.
account.wizardLead1: You can choose more than one.
account.wizardLead4: Tick every skill you already control. You can choose several; your level updates instantly.
account.skillsPickSeveral: You can tick several in each block.
account.levelLiveIdle: Tick skills and your level will appear here.
account.wizardLeadEquip: Your equipment and, optionally, people linked to your account.
account.wizardLeadEquipRental: Height, weight and sizes are essential so rental can give you the right gear.
account.wizardLeadEquipOwn: Enter the measurements of your own gear. Your instructor needs them before the lesson.
account.linkFound: We found {count} booking(s) with your email. Finish your profile to continue.
account.levelResultLead: We use this to shape your first lesson. Your instructor will refine it on snow.
account.levelResultEmpty: Tick at least one skill for each discipline. Your level updates as you go.
account.areaLead: Bookings, progress, team tips and your videos for corrections.
account.noUpcoming: You have no confirmed lesson yet. Book online or message us and we will set it up.
account.emptySelfSkills: You have not ticked skills yet. Edit your profile to update them.
account.noReportsYet: When your instructor fills in a report, you will see notes, skills and recommended runs here.
account.progressUnreadBanner: Your instructor has updated your progress.
account.mediaLead: Upload them for team video corrections. Videos up to 30 seconds and {mb} MB (1080p works best). Photos can appear in the live gallery if you choose; videos are never published on the site.
account.mediaInvalidType: This format is not allowed. Use a JPG/PNG photo or an MP4/MOV video.
account.mediaUploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
account.mediaPublished: Photo published to the live gallery.
account.mediaUnpublished: Photo removed from the live gallery.
account.mediaVideoNoGallery: Videos are for corrections only; they are not published in the gallery.
account.mediaVideoTooLong: Videos cannot be longer than {seconds} seconds.
account.mediaVideoInvalid: We could not read the video duration. Try MP4 or WebM.
account.mediaTooLarge: The file is too large (max {mb} MB). Trim the clip or record at 1080p.
account.mediaLimit: You have reached the upload limit.
account.confirmedEmpty: When we confirm a lesson it will appear here.
account.noBadges: Badges appear when your instructor fills in a report.
